what: Mistake: ran a stray 'git checkout origin/main --' while reading file sizes, which detached HEAD in the working copy drain commits to; drain's landing of verified job 20261026-232417-n33v (G8) then could not find its verification and failed twice, stopping the drain. Landed it by hand afterwards.
why: Read-only inspection used a checkout instead of git show or ls-tree; nothing guards the shared working copy against an inspection command while drain runs.
